meta.title: Las Vegas is growing while its lake disappears 🛰️ #shorts
meta.description:
Since 1984 Las Vegas grew by about two million people. Meanwhile its water source, Lake Mead, dropped roughly 50 metres in two decades of drought, leaving a white bathtub ring along the old shoreline.

Watch our planet change in seconds. Accelerated urban growth, geographic shifts and climate overviews from a clean satellite perspective.

📍 Las Vegas & Lake Mead, USA · 1984 → 2024
🎬 Stylized satellite reconstruction based on real-world change.
